# QR Tools

> Free browser tools for static QR code generation and local QR image reading. Optional Safari and Chrome extensions provide current-tab QR codes.

The website generates QR codes for URLs, text, Wi-Fi credentials, email, SMS and vCard 3.0 contacts. Users can change colors and error correction, export PNG or SVG, and read images or use a permitted camera. CSV batches support up to 100 static QR labels, PNG/SVG ZIP downloads and eight-label A4/Letter printing. Printable Wi-Fi, event and menu-link signs support PNG and browser print-to-PDF. Local content inspection explains URL structure without a reputation or safety guarantee. Single events provide a Google Calendar template-link QR and a separate ICS download, with explicit time zones. QR content, passwords, CSV files and images are processed in the browser, without server upload, website accounts or saved history.

Codes are static: encoded content does not update after distribution. This is not a hosted dynamic QR redirect or editable digital-profile service. Wi-Fi passwords and contact details can be read by anyone with the QR image. The website cannot inspect other browser tabs; that is an extension feature.

## Tools

- [Free Online QR Code Generator & Reader](https://qrtools.luopeike.com/index.md): Make free static QR codes for URLs, text, Wi-Fi, email, SMS and vCard contacts. Customize colors, export PNG or SVG, and scan QR images without uploading them.
- [Free Wi-Fi QR Code Generator for Guests](https://qrtools.luopeike.com/wifi-qr-code-generator.md): Create a Wi-Fi QR code for guests: network name, password, WPA/WPA2/WPA3 or WEP, open and hidden networks. Download PNG or SVG with no password upload.
- [Free vCard QR Code Generator for Contact Cards](https://qrtools.luopeike.com/contact-qr-code-generator.md): Make a static vCard 3.0 contact QR code with name, phone, email, company and website. Export your contact card as PNG or SVG without an account.
- [Free Online QR Code Reader for Images & Camera](https://qrtools.luopeike.com/qr-code-reader.md): Read QR codes from PNG, JPEG, GIF, WebP or BMP images, or use your camera. Decode locally, review the text and open links yourself. No image upload.
- [Bulk QR Code Generator from CSV & Printable Labels](https://qrtools.luopeike.com/bulk-qr-code-generator.md): Bulk QR code generator from CSV: preview up to 100 labels, download PNG/SVG ZIP and print on A4 or Letter. Local processing without an account.
- [QR Code URL Inspector & Local Content Check](https://qrtools.luopeike.com/qr-code-url-inspector.md): Inspect decoded QR contents and URL hostnames, protocols and parameters locally. Review suspicious structures before opening; no safety guarantee.
- [Printable Wi-Fi, Event & Menu QR Code Signs](https://qrtools.luopeike.com/printable-qr-code-sign.md): Create printable guest Wi-Fi QR signs, event entry cards and menu-link signs. Add a title and note, save PNG or print to PDF without an account.
- [Calendar Event QR Code Generator & ICS Download](https://qrtools.luopeike.com/calendar-event-qr-code-generator.md): Create a single-event Google Calendar link QR and download an ICS file for compatible calendars. Set start, end and time zone; no hosted event storage.

## Native App and Safari Extension

QR Tools: QR Code Reader is also a native iPhone, iPad and Mac app. It reads QR images or an available camera, generates six content types, imports up to 100 CSV labels, exports PNG/SVG/ZIP/PDF, makes printable signs and creates calendar-link QR codes with separate ICS files. Only explicitly saved content enters local App history. QR generation, decoding and CSV processing are local; opening a website or online calendar link uses that service. Local URL checks are not a website safety guarantee.

Enable QR Tools in Safari extension settings, open it on the current page, then scan the QR with another device to open the same address. Users can edit text or URLs and optionally remove tracking parameters, copy the image or save PNG/SVG. This shares an address, not a browser session. The native App includes the Safari extension; the desktop Chrome extension is a separate install. The website cannot read other tabs and does not save history.

- [QR Tools: QR Code Reader](https://qrtools.luopeike.com/qr-tools-app.md): Read a QR image or move a Safari page to your phone. Create Wi-Fi codes and CSV labels, then export PNG, SVG, ZIP or PDF with local QR processing.
- [QR Tools 二维码扫描与生成](https://qrtools.luopeike.com/zh-Hans/qr-tools-app.md): 把 Safari 当前页变成二维码，在另一台设备继续打开。也可读取图片、分享 Wi-Fi、制作 CSV 标签，并在设备上导出 PNG、SVG、ZIP 或 PDF。
- [QR Tools: QRCode 掃描器](https://qrtools.luopeike.com/zh-Hant/qr-tools-app.md): 把 Safari 目前分頁變成 QR Code，在另一台裝置繼續開啟。也可讀取圖片、分享 Wi-Fi、製作 CSV 標籤，並在裝置上匯出 PNG、SVG、ZIP 或 PDF。
- [QR Tools QRコードリーダー・作成](https://qrtools.luopeike.com/ja/qr-tools-app.md): SafariのページをQRにして別の端末へ。画像のQR読み取り、Wi-Fi共有、CSVラベル作成にも対応。PNG・SVG・ZIP・PDFを端末内で書き出せます。
- [QR Tools QR코드 스캐너·생성기](https://qrtools.luopeike.com/ko/qr-tools-app.md): Safari 페이지를 QR로 만들어 다른 기기에서 여세요. 이미지 QR 읽기, Wi-Fi 공유, CSV 라벨 생성과 기기 내 PNG·SVG·ZIP·PDF 내보내기도 지원합니다.
- [QR Tools: QR Code Scanner](https://qrtools.luopeike.com/de-DE/qr-tools-app.md): Eine Safari-Seite per QR aufs Handy senden, QR-Bilder lesen, WLAN teilen und CSV-Etiketten erstellen. PNG, SVG, ZIP und PDF lokal exportieren.
- [QR Tools: Lecteur de QR Code](https://qrtools.luopeike.com/fr-FR/qr-tools-app.md): Partagez une page Safari par QR. Lisez les QR des images, créez des codes Wi-Fi et des étiquettes CSV. Exportez PNG, SVG, ZIP ou PDF en local.
- [QR Tools: Lector y Generador](https://qrtools.luopeike.com/es-ES/qr-tools-app.md): Comparte una página de Safari por QR. Lee QR de imágenes, crea códigos Wi-Fi y etiquetas CSV. Exporta PNG, SVG, ZIP o PDF en tu dispositivo.
